descriptions.text: Mordecai's Special Brew. A potion designed by a shifty Changeling who has a tendency to kill those who count on him the most, this special potion combines the effects of a Gold Standard Healing Potion and the Troll's Second Wind to create a de facto immortality for a period of thirty seconds. It has a few unfortunate side effects.

recap.text: Mordecai gives Carl a pair of potions he made himself and explains that each brings thirty seconds of constant healing. It won't help against blowing yourself up or decapitation. Each adds about ten hours to the potion sickness countdown, and only two work before they stop. Carl slams one as Grull's axe comes down, and his shattered back, his pelvis under a flaming horseshoe, and the flattening by a rolling train car all heal.

Mordecai's Special Brew leaves a potion sickness timer in the upper left of Carl's vision, with over four hours left. Carl tells Donut to drink the brew if her health gets low, as the ceiling splinters. In the plane, he drags it onto Mordecai's other item, making a potion ball, and throws it from the xistera. It hits the puppy, whose health rockets up, but he stays asleep.

Edgar's plan for Louis runs on thirty seconds, but Louis's heart stops before anyone is ready. Bucket Boy yanks the old organs out and throws them over his shoulder. Edgar cries for the potion, and Donut, standing on a high chair over the open chest, pours Mordecai's Special Brew into the gushing chest as Imani places the new organs and Juice Box casts.

beats.headline: Thirty seconds, and a price
beats.text: Among Mordecai's gifts is a pair of potions of his own. He only had materials for two, he says, and needs at least four more. Carl ignores the first part of the description; he knows how the System labels things a crawler has made. What it does, Mordecai explains, is a constant stream of healing mixed with rapid regeneration for thirty seconds, healing almost anything and keeping health topped up. It is not invulnerability: it will not help against blowing yourself up or being decapitated. The side effects are severe. It adds about ten hours to the potion sickness countdown, and only two work before they stop altogether. He has been trying to fix that for ages.
beats.gist: Mordecai's potion heals almost anything for thirty seconds, but adds ten hours of sickness and works only twice.

beats.headline: On the hotlist
beats.text: Before agreeing to help Hekla's team, Carl rummages through his inventory and rearranges his hotlist. Into one slot goes the invisibility potion from the suitcase. Then Mordecai's Special Brew, for almost-invulnerability for about thirty seconds. He has to be careful with that one, because afterwards he cannot take another potion for ten hours. Okay, he says out loud. We'll help. Just don't get me killed so you can have Donut all to yourself.
beats.gist: Carl rearranges his hotlist, slotting in the invisibility potion and Mordecai's Special Brew, then agrees to help.

beats.headline: Broken and healed
beats.text: Grull lifts his axe. It will not hit Carl, but it will hit close enough to kill him, and Protective Shell will not help this time. He slams the potion. Gold-Standard! A thirty-second timer appears. The ground buckles and launches him into the wall of a train, the shockwave slams him again, and his back shatters over and over while he is healed again and again. Grull, blind in the smoke, steps on him with a flaming horseshoe and shatters his pelvis. A rolling train car flattens him. Each time, he heals.
beats.gist: Carl slams Mordecai's potion as Grull's axe falls, and its thirty-second timer heals him through every shattering blow.

beats.headline: Four hours to go
beats.text: Out in a driving sandstorm on the way to town, Carl catches a countdown timer in the upper left of his vision. It is his potion sickness indicator, left over from Mordecai's Special Brew. He still has over four hours before he can take another potion. At least the timer kept ticking while they were on Odette's show.
beats.gist: Carl catches his potion sickness timer from Mordecai's Special Brew in the sandstorm: over four hours remain.

beats.headline: If your health gets low
beats.text: The ceiling is about to give way over them. Take a water scroll, Carl tells Donut, and do it now; put the rest in your hotlist, fast. If your health gets low, don't take a health potion. Take Mordecai's Special Brew. Donut has changed her mind, she says; she would rather be buried alive than... Carl pulls her from his shoulder and wraps himself around her, muffling the rest, as the ceiling splinters and the sand pours in.
beats.gist: Donut is told to take a water scroll as the ceiling gives way, and Carl shields her.

beats.headline: Fired at a puppy
beats.text: In the plane, chasing Quan toward Orthrus, Carl sends Mordecai a frantic question and gets back one word: yes. He has Donut hand him the special brew and pulls it straight into his inventory, where he drags it onto the other item Mordecai gave him the same day he made the potion. They combine into a new item, a potion ball. As they dive at the dog, he loads it into the xistera and puts all his strength into the throw. The ball hits the puppy at the same moment Quan attacks. The dog glows, and his health rockets to the top. It does not wake him up.
beats.gist: Carl throws a potion ball made from Mordecai's special brew; it heals the puppy but doesn't wake him.

beats.headline: Into Louis's chest
beats.text: Edgar's plan for Louis runs on thirty seconds: Mordecai cuts him open, and once the naiad's organs are ready they administer the special brew, swap out the heart and lungs, Juice Box activates the new ones, and then the graft. Donut stands on a high chair over Louis's open chest, ready to drop the potion. Louis's heart stops before they are ready, and Bucket Boy yanks the old organs out and throws them over his shoulder. Potion! Edgar cries, and Donut pours Mordecai's Special Brew into the open, gushing chest as Imani places the new organs and Juice Box casts.
beats.gist: Donut pours Mordecai's Special Brew into Louis's gushing chest as Imani places the new organs.
